fusions.name: Marsh Snap
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Snaps a sticky spore at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 8 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Sudden Squelch
fusions.desc: A burst deals 14 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and stuns each for 1 second. Each hit has a 50% chance to leave the target [Diseased] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Dew Soak
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second for 6 seconds. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Lily Rest
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
